proof.text: Let α be the specified properOpenComparison. The sheaf adjunction j₂! ⊣ j₂⁻¹ has invertible unit by lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-unit-iso. Exactness permits its termwise bounded-below derived adjunction. The isomorphism D⁺(j₂⁻¹) ∘ D⁺(j₂!) ≅ id obtained from the sheaf unit makes the derived left adjoint fully faithful, hence its unit invertible. Its right triangle identity makes j₂⁻¹ of the derived counit invertible. Since α is j₂! of the inverse of properOpenIdentification followed by this counit, j₂⁻¹α is invertible. No further property of the construction of the specified identification is required.

proof.text: For an open immersion j and a morphism i with disjoint ranges, lemma-openclosed-vanishing-lowershriek gives i⁻¹ j! F = 0 for every module sheaf F. Apply the exact-functor cohomology identifications twice to deduce Hⁿ(i⁻¹j!K) = 0 for all n. The derived cohomology criterion gives i⁻¹j!K = 0; the fully faithful inclusion of D⁺ into D detects zero objects. This is the private helper isZero_restrict_extensionZero, proved here rather than stated as a new obligation.

proof.text: Fix an algebraic-closure point s of T₂ outside j₂(X). Spec of its field has one point, so the ranges of s and j₂ are disjoint. The ranges of j₁ and pullback.fst f s are also disjoint: a common point would, by j₁ ≫ f = j₂ and the pullback equation, map into both disjoint ranges. Step 2 kills both s⁻¹j₂!K and i⁻¹j₁!K on the geometric fibre. Apply isIso_geometricFiber_finite to f, s and j₁!K. Derived pushforward is additive (from its derived adjunction) and hence preserves zero, so this exchange isomorphism makes s⁻¹Rf_*j₁!K zero. Thus s⁻¹α is a map between zero objects and is invertible.

proof.text: For each n test Hⁿα on the universe-lifted algebraic-closure stalk at every point of T₂. Inside the open, lift the geometric point through j₂ and use step 1. Outside it, use step 3 and the identity map of its field spectrum. In each case mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso transports invertibility of derived pullback of α to invertibility of pullback of Hⁿα. The existing upperStarCompUliftSheafFiberIso (via isIso_uliftSheafFiber_comp_map_of_isIso_upperStar_map) transports it to the actual geometric stalk. Scheme.isIso_of_isIso_sheafFiber_map applies directly to module-valued sheaves, so no separate abelian-to-module inverse argument is needed. Finally DerivedCategory.Plus.isIso_iff makes α invertible.
